Definition: A control that shows items inside other items, like folders inside folders.
One entry in a tree. In Quorum, each entry is a TreeItem object.
A way of organizing things in levels, where each thing can hold other things below it.
An item that holds other items. Blue is the parent of Cyan in this tutorial.
An item held by another item. Cyan is a child of Blue.
An item together with everything inside it.
Showing or hiding the children of an item. This is also called expanding and collapsing.
The list of items from the top of the tree down to one item, such as Blue, then Purple, then Dark Purple.
How many items there are, such as the 3 items in the path to Dark Purple.
An item's position in order, such as first, second or third. Blue is the first item in the path to Dark Purple.
A small picture shown next to the text of an item.
